title: The jump the engine already has, in the actual world
question: One of these colonies hops instead of walking. Does the hop read as a different animal, or as an ant with a bug? And is it worth putting on a species of its own?
context_md:
Same wetland seed, same colony, same 36 frames. The only difference is one wire from Bias to Impulse.

The hop verb shipped on 2026-08-29 and **no species file authors it**, so the only place it has ever been rendered is a hand-built shelf over a drop. This is the first time it has run on generated ground with trees, water and a founded colony.

The trade is already visible in the counters: the hopper reaches **twice as deep** on a forage trip (18 cells against 9) and dies **three times as often** (10 against 3). Nothing is tuned -- the walking arm is byte-identical to the shipped ant.
